parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: Diamond and graphite are both crystalline solids made from carbon atoms. Graphite conducts electricity. Diamond does **not** conduct electricity.
parts.text: Name the type of lattice structure present in the crystalline solids diamond and graphite.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Explain why diamond does **not** conduct electricity.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: Separate samples of phosphorus(V) chloride and silicon(IV) chloride are each added to an excess of cold water.
parts.text: Write an equation for each reaction.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Describe the appearance of phosphorus(V) chloride and silicon(IV) chloride at room temperature.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Compare the appearance of the mixtures produced when each reaction is complete.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Describe what is meant by amphoteric.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the formula of a Period 3 oxide that is amphoteric.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
The melting points of different oxides are shown in Table 1.1.

Table 1.1

| oxide | melting point/$^{\circ}\text{C}$ | force of attraction broken during melting |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| $\text{SO}_{2}$ | $-73$ |  |
| $\text{H}_{2}\text{O}$ | $0$ |  |
| $\text{SiO}_{2}$ | $1610$ |  |
| $\text{Na}_{2}\text{O}$ | $1132$ |  |
| $\text{MgO}$ | $2852$ |  |
parts.text:
Complete Table 1.1 by identifying the strongest force of attraction in each oxide that is broken during melting. Use the abbreviations below.

i.d. = instantaneous dipole-induced dipole

p.d. = permanent dipole-permanent dipole

H = hydrogen bond

C = covalent bond

I = ionic bond

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.stem: A student suggests the following hypothesis.
parts.text:
*The stronger the covalent bond between atoms in non-metal oxides, the higher the melting point.*

Use Table 1.1 to deduce if this hypothesis is true or false or if there is **not** enough information to make a conclusion. Explain your answer.
